tiktok_title: Bangun jam 6, balita idealnya udah tidur jam 8 malam. Contekan jam tidur per usia
caption:
Balita 1-2 tahun butuh tidur malam sekitar 10-12 jam. Kalau bangunnya jam 6 pagi, berarti jam 8 malam udah tidur.

Total tidur sehari semalam, termasuk tidur siang (AASM, didukung AAP): bayi 4-12 bulan 12-16 jam, balita 1-2 tahun 11-14 jam, prasekolah 3-5 tahun 10-13 jam, anak SD 6-12 tahun 9-12 jam. Bayi di bawah 4 bulan 14-17 jam (WHO).

Sekarang masih tidur jam 10? Nggak apa-apa. Majuin pelan-pelan, yang penting jam tidur dan bangunnya ajek tiap hari.

Anakmu biasanya tidur malam jam berapa?

Sumber: AASM 2016, WHO 2019, Sydney Children's Hospitals Network, Plunket

sources: AASM pediatric consensus 2016 (Paruthi et al., J Clin Sleep Med), endorsed by AAP: 4-12 months 12-16 h, 1-2 years 11-14 h, 3-5 years 10-13 h per 24 h including naps, 6-12 years 9-12 h. No recommendation under 4 months. https://www.eurekalert.org/news-releases/685231

WHO 2019, Guidelines on physical activity, sedentary behaviour and sleep for children under 5: 0-3 months 14-17 h, 4-11 months 12-16 h, 1-2 years 11-14 h, 3-4 years 10-13 h with a nap optional, regular sleep and wake times. https://www.who.int/news/item/24-04-2019-to-grow-up-healthy-children-need-to-sit-less-and-play-more

Sydney Children's Hospitals Network (NSW Health), Sleep recommendations for toddlers: 1 and 2 year olds sleep about 10-12 hours at night, naps 1-2.5 h, consistent sleep and wake-up times. https://www.schn.health.nsw.gov.au/kids-health-hub/healthy-sleep-children/sleep-recommendations-age/sleep-recommendations-toddlers-1-3

Plunket (NZ), Sleep 1-2 years: 11-14 h in 24 h with a 10-12 hour sleep at night, typical bedtime 6.30-7 pm in its example with a 7 am wake-up. https://www.plunket.org.nz/child-development/sleep/sleep-1-2-years/sleep-1-2-years/

Tresillian, Responsive settling 12 months to toddler: bedtime routines should take no longer than 30 to 40 minutes. https://www.tresillian.org.au/media/0hdnauuu/tre-26_4331-tip-responsive-settling-12-months-to-toddler.pdf
notes: SHORT format (4 slides). Bedtimes are our arithmetic from a 6:00 wake-up: balita 6:00 minus the 10 h night floor (SCHN, Plunket) = 20:00, prasekolah without a nap 6:00 minus the 10 h total floor (AASM) = 20:00, SD 6:00 minus 9 h (AASM) = 21:00. No source gives a night-only figure for babies, so the baby row points to the wake-window post instead of a clock time. Bed art has no pillow or blanket to stay consistent with safe sleep.
